description:
In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), add three new expense accounts to the Chart of Accounts to better track operational costs.

Navigate to Settings -> Chart of Accounts and create the following accounts:

1. Name: 'Freight and Delivery', Code: '5100', Group: 'Expenses'
2. Name: 'Vehicle Maintenance', Code: '5200', Group: 'Expenses'
3. Name: 'Professional Services', Code: '5300', Group: 'Expenses'

Ensure all accounts are properly saved and appear in the list.
